    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Surging AI Agent：.NET 生态原生智能微服务引擎，让大模型与业务微服务融为一体</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h2>一、概述</h2>
<p>传统.NET 项目中，AI 大模型往往作为外部服务调用，业务微服务与大模型割裂，面临接口调试复杂、数据外传、部署链路冗长、多语言运维成本高等一系列难题。<strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">Surging AI Agent</strong>基于 Surging 分布式微服务引擎原生打造，把本地私有化大模型、向量 RAG 检索、微服务业务能力、智能 Agent 编排统一在一套.NET 技术栈，实现 AI 能力和业务微服务一体化开发、运行、部署、运维。</p>
<p><img alt="0a8b7db2d1903759f9785736e58ab1c3" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/192878/202608/192878-20260817224953229-535819366.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>🚀终端自然语言驱动，engine‑cli 开启智能开发时代</h2>
<div style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">Surging 通过<code style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">engine‑cli</code>命令行工具，将 AI 智能体深度嵌入研发工作流。开发者不用记忆复杂指令，直接使用自然语言和终端对话。</div>
<div style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">
<ul>
<li style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding-top: 0; padding-right: 0; padding-bottom: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-right: 0; margin-bottom: 0; background: none">提问框架原理，Agent 直接给出 Surging 架构讲解；</li>
<li style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding-top: 0; padding-right: 0; padding-bottom: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-right: 0; margin-bottom: 0; background: none">输入自然语言业务需求，智能体自动解析意图，自动生成完整微服务模块代码；</li>
<li style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding-top: 0; padding-right: 0; padding-bottom: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-right: 0; margin-bottom: 0; background: none">自动完成项目编译、模块输出、服务注册，一键产出可运行的业务 dll 模块，开箱即可启动微服务实例、自动生成 Swagger 接口文档。</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">
<div style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">从截图演示可见，只需要简单描述：<strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">生成订单中心微服务模块，生成商品、用户、订单明细全部业务模块</strong>，Agent 自动拆解子任务，输出完整模块组件，编译生成业务程序集，直接交付可运行微服务。同时支持查询服务列表、查看接口路由，实时掌握集群微服务状态。</div>
<div style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">
<p><img alt="01ec79ca11e9342586855a04deed5a32" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/192878/202608/192878-20260817222212637-1268496259.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2>&nbsp;🧠 私有化本地大模型一键部署，数据不出内网</h2>
<p>依托 LLamaSharp 原生 C# 推理能力，engine‑cli 内置模型管理能力，一行命令即可拉取、管理 GGUF 格式开源大模型，完全离线私有化运行，业务敏感数据无需对外传输。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>engine‑cli install model ‑s ‑t llama ‑‑limit 10</pre>
</div>
<p>支持 Meta‑Llama‑3.1‑8B 等主流开源大模型，支持多种量化版本，普通开发机器即可运行；支持 CPU 纯内存运行，也可 GPU 加速推理，灵活适配开发、生产环境硬件条件。</p>
<p><img alt="2f108ae83ee4eec0d40a2a02a4c78252" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/192878/202607/192878-20260726203107772-491729565.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2>&nbsp;📚 内置向量模型，开箱即用 RAG 知识库体系</h2>
<p>除大语言模型外，CLI 工具同样支持一键下载 BGE‑small 向量 Embedding 模型，快速搭建 RAG 向量知识库，支持文档解析、向量化入库、相似度检索，用于框架文档问答、业务知识库智能检索场景。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>engine‑cli install model ‑t bge‑small ‑e ‑‑limit 10</pre>
</div>
<p>不需要引入 Python 环境，全部在.NET 栈完成向量计算与检索；支持精细化文档分层，提升检索准确度，为 Agent 提供可靠的领域知识库支撑，缓解大模型幻觉问题。</p>
<p><img alt="64df474595436b664829b8f6b90b137d" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/192878/202607/192878-20260726203127295-495657990.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2>&nbsp;⚡AI Agent 无缝调用业务微服务能力</h2>
<div style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">Surging AI Agent 最大的优势：<strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">Agent 智能体可以直接调用现有微服务接口能力</strong>。
<div style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">&nbsp;</div>
Agent 不需要额外写大量适配胶水代码，直接复用 Surging 引擎的 HTTP、WebSocket、GRPC 通信协议，访问已注册微服务路由接口。</div>
<div style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">
<ul style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">
<li style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">查询用户微服务列表，读取业务接口元数据；</li>
<li style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">调用订单、日志等业务服务完成数据查询；</li>
<li style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">Agent 结合大模型推理 + 业务接口返回真实业务数据，完成智能问答、业务分析。</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">
<div style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">微服务启动后自动输出 Swagger 文档，Agent 能够感知全部对外接口，把 AI 智能能力注入业务系统，打通 “大模型思考” 到 “业务系统执行” 的完整闭环。</div>
<div style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">

<h2>✨核心亮点总结</h2>
<div style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none"><ol>
<li style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding-top: 0; padding-right: 0; padding-bottom: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-right: 0; margin-bottom: 0; background: none"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">全栈.NET 原生</strong>：大模型推理、向量检索、Agent 编排、微服务业务全部 C# 实现，告别多语言混合项目。</li>
<li style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding-top: 0; padding-right: 0; padding-bottom: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-right: 0; margin-bottom: 0; background: none"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">私有化离线部署</strong>：本地运行 LLM+BGE 向量模型，业务数据不对外流出，满足企业内网安全要求。</li>
<li style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding-top: 0; padding-right: 0; padding-bottom: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-right: 0; margin-bottom: 0; background: none"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">自然语言驱动开发</strong>：engine‑cli Agent，对话式生成微服务模块，自动编译输出业务组件，大幅提升开发效率。</li>
<li style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding-top: 0; padding-right: 0; padding-bottom: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-right: 0; margin-bottom: 0; background: none"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">Agent 直接调用微服务</strong>：复用现有 RPC、HTTP、GRPC 能力，业务接口直接作为 Agent 工具，无需复杂适配。</li>
<li style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding-top: 0; padding-right: 0; padding-bottom: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-right: 0; margin-bottom: 0; background: none"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">统一运维管控</strong>：AI 推理服务与业务微服务由 Surging 服务管理器统一管控，统一端口、注册发现、日志监控。</li>
<li style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding-top: 0; padding-right: 0; padding-bottom: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-right: 0; margin-bottom: 0; background: none"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">面向未来扩展</strong>：架构原生支持多模态模型扩展，后续可接入 LLaVA 等多模态模型，实现图片文档识别生成代码等高级能力。</li>
</ol>
<h2>&nbsp;结尾</h2>
<p>现在测试研发多模态模型，整个Agent 是组件化开发，后续会接入到我研发的云驿平台。我还购买了com 域名， 我是要准备干票大的，让你们看看surging的真正威力。</p>
